**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/26 (Sun) 20:40  
[EVENT] User is thinking of reorganizing bathroom cabinets to make room for new skincare products.  
[EVENT] User recently restocked on toilet paper, buying a 24-pack of Charmin Ultra Soft from Costco about three weeks ago.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on stocking up on toilet paper and provided tips for maximizing bathroom cabinet storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips provided by the assistant include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Purge and declutter: Sort items into keep, donate/sell, and discard piles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Use vertical space: Install shelves, stackable containers, or baskets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Choose multi-functional storage: Invest in storage units that serve multiple purposes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Optimize cabinet layout: Store frequently used items in the "golden zone" (waist to shoulder height).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Utilize the back of the cabinet door: Use over-the-door storage racks or adhesive hooks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Group similar items together: Store similar products in the same area.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Consider a turntable or lazy Susan for easy access.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Label and categorize storage containers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Store less frequently used items out of the way.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Keep it tidy: Set aside time each week to maintain organization.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the tips provided by the assistant.  
[EVENT] User is thinking of getting stackable containers to store skincare products.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended good brands/types of stackable containers that are easy to clean and have good ventilation:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Acrylic containers: The Container Store's Acrylic Storage Containers, Sterilite's Acrylic Storage Containers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Clear plastic containers: Rubbermaid's Brilliance Storage Containers, OXO's Good Grips Storage Containers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Mesh containers: Seville Classics' Mesh Storage Bins, Sorbus' Mesh Storage Containers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Stackable drawer organizers: Whitmor's Stackable Drawer Organizers, Seville Classics' Stackable Drawer Organizers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing containers include material, size, ventilation, and stackability.  
[EVENT]
